Effect_on_Production: Actuators slow down or fail to complete stroke; cycle time increases; quality risk
Signal_Signature: Pressure < 6.5 bar; Flow increases slightly (system compensates)
How_to_Induce_Passively: Turn main pressure regulator down to ~5.0 bar
Condition_Monitoring_Method: Continuous pressure monitoring with low-pressure threshold alarm
Recommended_Action: Inspect all push-in fittings and seals; tighten or replace

Failure_Cause: Partially clogged valve or kinked tubing
Effect_on_Production: Actuator moves slower; longer cycle times; incomplete strokes possible
Signal_Signature: Flow drops ~50%; Pressure remains near nominal; cycle time increases
How_to_Induce_Passively: Partially close a manual inline needle valve to ~50% open
Condition_Monitoring_Method: Continuous flow monitoring with low-flow threshold alarm
Recommended_Action: Clean or replace directional valve; inspect tubing for kinks

Failure_Cause: Fully seized actuator or completely closed solenoid valve
Effect_on_Production: Station stalls; production stops at that station; downstream starved
Signal_Signature: Flow drops to ~0 L/min; Pressure elevated; TotalPower drops to idle
How_to_Induce_Passively: Fully close manual flow control valve to one actuator circuit
Condition_Monitoring_Method: Continuous flow monitoring with zero-flow alarm; cycle-time watchdog
Recommended_Action: Replace seized actuator or failed solenoid valve immediately

Failure_Cause: Bearing wear / belt misalignment / overloaded pallet
Effect_on_Production: Motor draws excess current; risk of thermal overtrip; belt may slip
Signal_Signature: Current L2 or L3 increases 20-50% above baseline; TotalPower rises proportionally
How_to_Induce_Passively: Place extra measured weight (books/sandbags) on a conveyor pallet
Condition_Monitoring_Method: Continuous current monitoring with overcurrent alarm per phase
Recommended_Action: Inspect and re-tension belt; check and grease bearings; reduce pallet load

Failure_Cause: Sensor not detecting pallet; upstream station did not release pallet
Effect_on_Production: Station cycles without workpiece; no value-added work; OEE Availability loss
Signal_Signature: TotalPower drops to ~30% of normal; Flow drops sharply; cycle still completes
How_to_Induce_Passively: Remove pallet from conveyor and let station execute an empty cycle
Condition_Monitoring_Method: Cycle-completion verification; part-present sensor cross-check in MES4
Recommended_Action: Investigate pallet feed mechanism; verify detection sensor alignment and calibration

Failure_Cause: Belt tension loss / worn drive roller / undersized motor
Effect_on_Production: Longer transport time between stations; throughput drops; OEE Performance loss
Signal_Signature: TotalPower slightly lower; cycle time measurably longer; current slightly lower
How_to_Induce_Passively: Reduce conveyor speed via MES4 parameter or hardware speed potentiometer
Condition_Monitoring_Method: Cycle-time watchdog in MES4; periodic belt tension inspection
Recommended_Action: Re-tension or replace belt; adjust drive roller; check motor coupling

Failure_Cause: Loose terminal connection or blown fuse on one phase
Effect_on_Production: Unbalanced load stresses motor windings; reduced torque; risk of motor damage over time
Signal_Signature: One phase Active Power drops significantly while others remain near normal; PowerFactor shifts on that phase
How_to_Induce_Passively: Disable one sub-station in MES4 that primarily loads one phase
Condition_Monitoring_Method: Continuous per-phase power monitoring; power imbalance ratio alarm
Recommended_Action: Inspect and tighten all terminal connections on affected phase; check fuses

Failure_Cause: Dust / oil / physical object on sensor lens
Effect_on_Production: Missed detection events; station enters retry loop; false-positive or false-negative readings
Signal_Signature: Station enters retry/search loop; power consumption pattern shows repeated short actuations; cycle time increases irregularly
How_to_Induce_Passively: Place tape or a small cardboard piece partially over the RASS sensor detection face
Condition_Monitoring_Method: Cycle-count anomaly detection in MES4; periodic sensor lens cleaning schedule
Recommended_Action: Clean sensor lens; increase cleaning frequency; add protective cover if environment is dusty

Component: Main Pneumatic Supply / Power Supply Relay
Failure_Cause: Unstable supply / relay contact bouncing / loose main terminal
Effect_on_Production: Random brief stoppages; upstream starvation; increased short-stop count in OEE
Signal_Signature: Pressure and Flow spike to 0 for 2-3 seconds then recover; Power dips in sync; creates sawtooth pattern in time series
How_to_Induce_Passively: Briefly toggle the main air supply valve on/off 3-4 times during a recording session
Condition_Monitoring_Method: Event-driven alerting in MES4 on pressure drops below threshold; MTBF tracking for short stops
Recommended_Action: Inspect main supply valve; check relay contacts; tighten main terminal connections

Failure_Cause: Regulator stuck open / set too high; upstream pressure increase
Effect_on_Production: Faster actuator movements; risk of seal damage over time; higher air consumption and cost
Signal_Signature: Pressure reads 7.5-8.0 bar (vs nominal 6.9); Flow increases; actuator cycle completes faster
How_to_Induce_Passively: Turn pressure regulator up to ~8.0 bar (within safe operating range for CP Factory)
Condition_Monitoring_Method: Continuous pressure monitoring with high-pressure threshold alarm; regulator annual calibration check
Recommended_Action: Recalibrate or replace pressure regulator; reduce supply pressure to nominal

Failure_Cause: Early-stage seal wear; minor fitting leak beginning
Effect_on_Production: Slight actuator slowdown; cycle time marginally increased; no immediate risk
Signal_Signature: Pressure ~6.5 bar (vs nominal ~7.4); Flow slightly higher; cycle times barely affected
How_to_Induce_Passively: Turn FRL pressure regulator down to ~6.5 bar on Mpress station
Condition_Monitoring_Method: Continuous pressure monitoring with trend analysis for gradual degradation
Recommended_Action: Schedule FRL regulator inspection; monitor seal condition

Failure_Cause: Progressive seal degradation; moderate fitting leak
Effect_on_Production: Actuators noticeably slower; occasional cycle delays; throughput reduced
Signal_Signature: Pressure ~5.5 bar; Flow pattern changes; Power shows longer actuator cycles
How_to_Induce_Passively: Turn FRL pressure regulator down to ~5.5 bar on Mpress station
Condition_Monitoring_Method: Continuous pressure monitoring with low-pressure alarm threshold at 6.0 bar
Recommended_Action: Inspect and replace push-in fittings and seals; recalibrate FRL regulator
